summary: Iteration 3 focused testing on the two new features: (1) Dashboard subscription widget label change to 'Reels-uri rămase' with storage bar removed, and (2) the 'Ce vrei să faci?' mode selector with prompt vs subtitle branches. Backend: 19/19 pytest passing (added TestGenerateModes.test_generate_subtitle_mode + test_generate_prompt_mode). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow (login → upload → open detail → toggle modes → generate subtitle plan via real Claude → verify read-only subtitle list, badge, absence of post details, absence of edit inputs → approve → verify export buttons → delete) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_ai_plan: relies on the model returning strict JSON — has JSON cleanup fallback (trailing commas, ellipsis) but still could 502 on malformed AI output. Consider a retry loop with tighter prompt if flakiness appears in production.
server.py generate-plan endpoint accepts mode via query string only; consider validating via Pydantic Query(regex='^(prompt|subtitle)$') for stricter API surface.
server.py CORS still allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — same finding as iter_1/2. Not related to this iteration's diff.
ProjectDetail.jsx flowIndex('approved') still returns 5 — Aprobare/Export nodes never light up (carry-over from iter_2, still LOW priority).

ProjectDetail.jsx: activeMode falls back to local state 'mode' if project.mode is missing; correct behavior, but if a very old project (pre-mode) is regenerated the badge only appears after refresh — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created + deleted TEST_MODE_UI_Reel. Backend TestGenerateModes creates+deletes TEST_Subtitle_Mode and TEST_Prompt_Mode per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button label is 'Intră în cont' (not 'Autentificare'). Upload modal submit button is 'Încarcă și creează proiect'. Upload input testid = projects-upload-input. Real Claude subtitle generation returned in ~5s, prompt in ~10-15s. Mode selector only visible when project.status === 'uploaded'; existing seeded projects (Deadlift, Antrenament piept explosiv, TEST_UI_Reel, TEST_FE_Project) are already past that state so a NEW upload is required to see it.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. All specified behavior for the two requested changes is implemented and verified.
